entries.en: Think of your friends who died on Akuze. Would they want revenge... or justice?
entries.tr: Akuze'de ölen arkadaşlarını düşün. İntikam mı isterlerdi... yoksa adalet mi?

entries.en: You put on a uniform, Corporal. You swore an oath. Don't let them take that from you.
entries.tr: Üniforma giydin Onbaşı. Yemin ettin. Bunu senden almalarına izin verme.

entries.en: Because you want to see him squirm on trial as all his ugly deeds come out.
entries.tr: Çünkü tüm çirkin işleri ortaya çıkarken onun yargılamada kıvranmasını görmek istiyorsun.

entries.en: Those bastards can't hurt you any more. Joker, tell the Fifth Fleet we need a ship for pick-up.
entries.tr: O piçler artık sana zarar veremez. Joker, Beşinci Filo'ya almak için bir gemiye ihtiyacımız olduğunu söyle.

entries.en: All you can do is keep going. Joker, tell the Fifth Fleet we need a ship for pick-up.
entries.tr: Yapabileceğin tek şey devam etmek. Joker, Beşinci Filo'ya almak için bir gemiye ihtiyacımız olduğunu söyle.

entries.en: Talk to me, Toombs. Whatever happened, this isn't the way.
entries.tr: Konuş benimle Toombs. Ne olduysa, yol bu değil.

entries.en: Toombs? But you were on Akuze! I saw the thresher maw pull you under!
entries.tr: Toombs? Ama sen Akuze'deydin! Thresher maw'ın seni yere çektiğini gördüm!

entries.en: Corporal Toombs? But... I saw you die on Akuze! How did you get here?
entries.tr: Onbaşı Toombs? Ama... Akuze'de öldüğünü gördüm! Buraya nasıl geldin?

entries.en: What all comes out? I'm listening, but I need you to put that gun down.
entries.tr: Neler ortaya çıkacak? Dinliyorum ama o silahı bırakmanı istiyorum.

entries.en: What are you talking about? Why do you want to kill this man?
entries.tr: Neden bahsediyorsun? Bu adamı neden öldürmek istiyorsun?

entries.en: Lower your weapon and step away from the doctor slowly, or I will fire.
entries.tr: Silahını indir ve doktordan yavaşça uzaklaş, yoksa ateş ederim.

entries.en: We don't always get what we want, Toombs.
What did the doctor do to you, Corporal?
What did they do to you, Toombs?
Toombs, I-- I didn't see anybody. If I'd seen you, I'd have come back for you. I swear.
entries.tr: Toombs, ben-- Kimseyi görmedim. Seni görseydim geri gelirdim. Yemin ederim.

entries.en: You're killing them because they killed your unit.
What kind of tests are we talking about?
But you died!
Toombs?
Let me help you.
Put the gun down!
[Shoot him.]
You don't have to do this.
Let's discuss this.
What kind of tests?
I didn't know.
They let your team die.
So this is revenge.
Think about this!
Let's make this public.
This isn't justice.
He was hurting.
You two had a past.
You don't get off that easy.
Go ahead, then.
It's my job.
You have to live.
Honor your unit.
Because you're a soldier.
This is worse for him.
You did a good job.
I do. It doesn't.
Damn it Shepard, this is my kill! You got out with a few scratches and a scary reputation! I'm the one they tortured!
entries.tr: Lanet olsun Shepard, bu benim avım! Sen birkaç çiziğe ve korkutucu bir ünle çıktın! İşkence gören bendim!

entries.en: Don't tell me who I am! You got away with a few scratches and a scary reputation!
entries.tr: Bana kim olduğumu söyleme! Sen birkaç çizik ve korkutucu bir ünle kurtuldun!

entries.en: The rest of the unit died, and I was tortured for years, Shepard! You can't judge me. You don't have the right.
entries.tr: Birimin geri kalanı öldü ve ben yıllarca işkence gördüm Shepard! Beni yargılayamazsın. Hakkın yok.

entries.en: I avenged them, Shepard. Our unit can finally rest in peace. I can finally let go.
entries.tr: Onların intikamını aldım Shepard. Birimimiz sonunda huzur içinde dinlenebilir. Sonunda bırakabilirim.

entries.en: The vids say that you were the sole survivor of what happened at Akuze. Who am I to argue?
entries.tr: Videolara göre Akuze'de olanlardan tek sağ kalan sendin. Ben kim oluyorum da itiraz edeyim?

entries.en: Mr. Toombs, you're insane! You need help!
entries.tr: Bay Toombs, delisiniz! Yardıma ihtiyacınız var!

entries.en: Can't you see that Toombs is crazy? Shoot him!
entries.tr: Toombs'un deli olduğunu görmüyor musun? Vur onu!

entries.en: Toombs is clearly crazy! Please, officer, help me!
entries.tr: Toombs açıkça deli! Lütfen memur bey, bana yardım edin!

entries.en: I got off easy, and you didn't. So let me handle this, Toombs.
entries.tr: Ben kolay kurtuldum, sen kurtulamadın. Bunu bana bırak Toombs.

entries.en: If I'd seen you, Toombs, I would never have left you behind. Let me help now.
entries.tr: Seni görseydim Toombs, seni asla geride bırakmazdım. Şimdi yardım etmeme izin ver.

entries.en: And I'm the one they can't prosecute, Toombs. You don't get to throw your life away so easily.
entries.tr: Ve ben kovuşturulamayan kişiyim Toombs. Hayatını bu kadar kolay atamazsın.

entries.en: We swore an oath when we put on this uniform! Would our unit want revenge or justice?
entries.tr: Bu üniformayı giydiğimizde yemin ettik! Birimimiz intikam mı isterdi, adalet mi?

entries.en: Toombs, if I could've helped you on Akuze, I would have. All I can do is help now. Let me.
entries.tr: Toombs, Akuze'de yardım edebilseydim ederdim. Yapabileceğim tek şey şimdi yardım etmek. İzin ver.

entries.en: You think I don't want revenge for Akuze? Listen, Toombs. Arresting him hurts them more.
entries.tr: Akuze'nin intikamını istemediğimi mi sanıyorsun? Dinle Toombs. Onu tutuklamak onlara daha çok zarar verir.

entries.en: This is my job.
It's better this way.
You're still a soldier!
I couldn't help then.
But... you can't do that!
Watch me. Joker, let the Fifth Fleet know we need a ship for pick-up.
entries.tr: İzle beni. Joker, Beşinci Filo'ya almak için bir gemiye ihtiyacımız olduğunu bildir.

entries.en: It's better than you deserve. Joker, let the Fifth Fleet know we need a ship for pick-up.
entries.tr: Hak ettiğinden iyi. Joker, Beşinci Filo'ya almak için bir gemiye ihtiyacımız olduğunu bildir.

entries.en: You don't think so?
Yes, Doctor, I can.
You've earned a lot worse.
Commander Shepard was there! She knows the truth.
entries.tr: Komutan Shepard oradaydı! O gerçeği biliyor.

entries.en: Shepard was at Akuze. That's all the proof she needs.
Commander Shepard was at Akuze. She knows the truth.
Commander Shepard was at Akuze. I doubt you will receive much sympathy from her.
entries.tr: Komutan Shepard Akuze'deydi. Ondan çok sempati göreceğinizi sanmıyorum.
